examples.quote: A live JuliaCall startup crashed before model code. The existing PR #1565 documented the launch-only bundled-libunwind workaround; the retry passed without importing or editing that PR. The remote archive initially lacked Git metadata, causing a source-only audit to stop before its intended assertion. Exact-baseline Git metadata restored the premise without changing source bytes, and that audit passed on rerun. Predecessor full runs were stopped only after final-source runs were active; their partial logs remain distinct.
